Market today: Tech is getting hammered, especially chip names, driven by earnings misses. This is hitting your concentrated book hard.

Your holdings: SMCI (-21.54%), METU (-17.28%), MU (-27.45%), SOXL (-54.44%), and SPAL (-40.52%) are all marked SELL. These leveraged ETFs and chip names are bleeding. QQQI (-4.73%) and SMH (-11.74%) are TRIM. CRWD (49.29%) is your lone bright spot.

Watch: Keep an eye on Intel's reaction after its earnings plunge.

Bottom line: Your leveraged tech bets are in serious trouble; focus on damage control.
plays: Trim SOXL and SPAL further if they show weakness today.
Consider cutting SMCI, METU, and MU if they don't rebound immediately.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
